title: 第2章 受辱
content_zh:
第二天一大早，雷豪还在睡梦中就听到一阵阵闹哄哄的声音，他朦胧中嘟囔了一句“胖子，这么早，搞你妹啊。安静点让我再睡会。”说完翻了个身，坚硬的石床让他觉得不对，他的床哪有这么硬，就这一下他清醒了，他没敢睁眼，黑暗中用手摸了摸，然后手就颓然的松开了。慢慢的睁开了双眼就看见了幽暗的山洞顶，而不是他所熟悉的雪白天花板。

他失魂落魄的从坚硬、冰冷的石床上爬了起来。也就是他现在这身子骨，要是以前那脆弱的大学生身体就这么睡一晚上，现在估计是腰酸背疼腿抽筋了。

站在石室门口的雷豪看着外面的小妖来来去去的忙碌着，他迷茫着不知道该干点什么。

“兄弟，你快过来，大统领马上就要点卯操练了。”雷豪正发着呆，豹二十远远的看着他就喊道。雷豪看到豹二十在叫他也就赶紧的走了过去，这豹妖现在可是他的先管，他可能不得罪了这豹二十，“无论如何，活下去再说。”雷豪暗暗的对自己说道。

豹二十带着雷豪，一路上呼朋唤友的带着一大群小妖，朝洞口赶去。当雷豪他们赶到洞口校场的时候，那里已经聚集了黑压压的一片妖怪。对，就是黑压压的一片，雷豪记得以前看西游记的时候每次孙悟空打上门去，那些妖王就带着几十个小妖就冲了出来，现在看来真他妈的扯淡，这起码得两三千小妖啊。

“豹二十，你看看都什么时辰了，新妖不知道难道你作为一个小统领也不知道点卯是什么时辰？”远远的雷豪就听见一声大喝，特别是那个“小”字咬得非常清楚，声音如虎啸。定神一看，却是一虎妖，身高两丈，胳膊比现在的雷豪大腿都粗。凶神恶煞的表情看得雷豪就是双腿一软。

豹二十抬头看了看天，然后带着一脸谄媚的笑容哈着腰向虎妖走去，真难为他猥琐狰狞的脸上竟然能做出这么复杂的表情。“虎大统领，是小的错了，你就绕过小的这一次吧。”豹二十讨好的对着虎妖说道。

“哼，饶？就是饶了你们太多次，上次才会被蛇妖洞那群软骨头杀的大败，虎七，虎八给我抽他们一妖一百鞭子，给他们长长记性，好让他们记住咱们水脏洞的规矩。”虎妖大喝。

豹二十的脸色变了变，却还是麻利的趴在了地上，在水脏洞活了一百多年的豹二十非常清楚眼前的虎大统领很不好惹，他可是水脏洞仅有的三位内丹境大妖之一，连大王每次弄到的宝贝都会分一些的虎大统领。

雷豪看着豹二十就这么趴在了地上准备挨鞭子都有些反应不过来，刚才不是说操练么？迟到了就要抽鞭子？用得着抽一百鞭子这么严重？他显然还以为这是大学。

看着豹二十趴在了地上，豹二十手下的一众小妖都赶紧的趴在了地上，好像唯恐趴的慢了一样。雷豪虽然不愿，但现在也没有更好的办法，反抗？扯淡，看看那虎大统领，高出雷豪一个头就不说了，满嘴的虎牙也就不说了，可看看那虎大统领的手臂，比自己的大腿还粗上一圈啊。虽然穿越为一个小妖很蛋疼，但他还没想这么快再穿越一次，谁知道这次死了是穿越当X片男主角还是穿越到其他动物上，这次还有个人形，要是变成其他禽兽乐子可就大了。

两只虎妖很快带着一帮小妖过来了，行刑开始，一只肥得就像一座小山一样的猪妖一鞭子一鞭子的抽在了雷豪的身上。

很痛，智商低下的小妖根本不懂什么叫放水，虽然大家同是妖怪，但这只猪妖看上去就知道做妖的时间肯定比雷豪要久得多。面目更加狰狞，也更加孔武有力。雷豪本来以为没什么，连豹二十这个小统领都挨鞭子了，没什么难受的。可是他忘记了，他心里是人，而那些，是妖。

鞭子还在继续，一鞭子一鞭子的抽在了雷豪的身体上，也抽在了雷豪的心中，把他求学这十几年建立起来的虚伪保护壳抽的粉碎。

这个神秘瑰丽的西游世界就以这顿鞭子迎接了还有些懵懂的雷豪。

屈辱不停的撕咬着雷豪的内心，他是猥琐，他是平凡，他是明白自己什么都不是。但他也曾经热血过。他忘不了中学的时候跟人干架的一幕幕，忘不掉他和兄弟满身伤却笑得那么猖狂的一幕幕，忘不掉被围殴在人群中却努力互相扶持不想倒下的一幕幕，这一切的一切他都忘不了。只是现实逼着他虚伪，逼着他放弃了拳头，拿起了笔；逼着他把向外的棱角都收回去朝着自己，多少次都刺疼得他午夜一个人流泪。但为了不让他的爸妈因为他而到处给人道歉，为了他的爸妈不被亲戚朋友说闲话，为了他的爸妈不再把辛苦挣来的钱弯着腰送给别人。他的血也就冷了，吃点小亏也就算了，受点气也就忍了，他觉得他可以不要脸了，尊严什么的也都无所谓了。

而现在被一头猪妖一鞭子一鞭子抽在身上的雷豪才知道，原来他一直以来的无所谓都是假的，原来他的血还是滚烫的，他还无法做到被狠狠的抽上一顿鞭子并且可以忍气吞声当作什么都没发生。他死死的咬着牙，死死的盯着那头虎妖，盯着那头压根就没正眼看过雷豪一眼的虎妖，连他已经满嘴都是血都不知道。“都是没实力，都是没实力，我要有实力，我要有混世魔王的实力这虎妖敢抽我的鞭子？我要有孙悟空的实力这虎妖敢抽我鞭子？我要有太上老君的实力这虎妖敢抽我鞭子？我要有鸿钧的实力这虎妖敢抽我鞭子？”雷豪心中疯狂的嚎叫着，他从来没有一刻像现在这样渴望实力，这样渴望有保护自己尊严的实力。

和周围发出此起彼伏惨叫声的小妖不一样，雷豪从头到尾都一声不吭，不是他皮厚不疼，也不是他的忍耐力有多么的好，只是他不愿喊出声，喊出了声就代表他认输了，他就这么流着血盯着虎大统领挨完了整整一百鞭子。

那只若干年后连雷豪名字都忘记了的虎妖不知道，他这一顿鞭子，到底唤醒的是一个怎样的存在，直到他死在雷豪的手上他都不知道。

100鞭子终于抽完了，被抽的基本上都是昨天刚启蒙的小妖，实力低，肉体强度低，可行刑的都是以前的妖兵，虽然同是小妖，但实力起码比他们强上一倍，这一顿鞭子下来，除了豹二十没什么事站起来拍了拍身上的尘土，其他的基本上都爬不起来。血肉模糊得隐隐约约都能见到白森森的骨头了怎么爬得起来，比较弱的已经进气多出气少，眼看这就快不行了。可别说虎妖统领连豹二十脸上都没什么变化，妖族，强者为尊，没实力的废物死了也就死了。

虎妖统领转过头看了看地上这群吭吭唧唧的“伤妖”不耐烦的挥了挥手道：“一群废物，都滚回去，今天点卯操练就不用来了。”那神情就像是在赶一群恶心的苍蝇。

听虎妖统领的话刚松了一口气准备回洞养伤的雷豪再一次被虎妖统领的神情刺伤了。他深吸一口气，双手死死的撑着地一点一点的爬了起来，虽然疼得他双手青筋挑起老高，脸色都青了又红，但他却依旧一声不吭。

“虎统领，小的牛十三请求加入点卯操练。”雷豪站起来大声的喊道，就像是声音大一点身上的疼痛就能少一点，虽然是喊小的，可他那老实的脸上现在却满是坚毅，也不带一点谄媚。

虎妖听到雷豪的声音再一次转过头看了一眼，视线停留在了雷豪身上几秒种就移开了，他根本没把雷豪当回事，这种小妖，他都不知道亲手宰了多少。

“滚进去。”这次连头都不转就这样轻喝了一声。

雷豪一步一步的走向了妖群，身上流出的血在刚刚升起太阳的照耀下反射出刺眼的光芒，长长的就像是一条霓虹灯大道，刺得雷豪身后的豹二十都沉默了，只是盯着雷豪血肉模糊的后背，不知道再想些什么。

=============================分隔线=============================

当操练结束后脸色苍白得已经不见一点血色的雷豪，回到石室后已经快正午了，小妖们已经在忙着烧火煮饭，肉香即使在充斥着，水脏洞内各种小妖的体臭也是那么的清晰。可雷豪一点胃口也没有，一上午他都带着一身的伤操练，身上出了一身又一身的冷汗，现在的他就像生了一场大病。但他不后悔没有回洞中养伤，不为别的，就为了告诉他自己，他雷豪，还能战斗，还没有被虚伪的世界废掉。虽然一上午的操练对他的肉身来说没多大用，但这是他战胜自己惰性的第一步。

他要成为强者，而强者，本来就是强着强着就成就强者。

雷豪趴在冰冷的石床上皱着眉头大口的吸着空气，神志模糊快要昏迷的时候，一阵脚步声由远到近很快停留在了他的石床前。“牛兄弟，牛兄弟醒醒。”雷豪费力的睁开了双眼，一看，是豹二十，手里还端着一大盆子肉。

“豹统领，你怎么来了。”雷豪就挣扎着要起来，“兄弟，兄弟别动，来，看哥给你带了一些血食，你今天受了伤，多吃点好得快。”豹二十阻止了雷豪，把盆子放到了雷豪的面前。雷豪这才看清楚盆子里是什么，是肉，但竟然全部是生肉，血淋淋还冒着热气的生肉。

雷豪看得胃中里一阵阵翻涌，豹二十看了雷豪的神情很平静的说：“咱们妖族本来就是吃血食才能强大，只是那群废物为了点口腹之欲开始吃什么熟食，吞了这些血食，补充一些血气，你的伤明天就能好，我多少次重伤都是这样挺过来的。”

雷豪抬起头看了看豹妖，又低头看了看盆子里还带着血的肉，沉默了，豹二十只是盯着雷豪，却也不开口催他。片刻之后，他伸了手抓起了盆子里的肉，一小口一小口的撕咬，咸咸的，很腥，喉咙一直想要往外吐他都生生的压了下来。他虽然不快，但速度很稳定，一口接着一口，似要记住这个味道，又似乎是在告诉自己，他不再是人，是妖。

豹二十看着雷豪一点点的吃完盆子里的血食，也沉默了，片刻之后才开口：“你，作为一个牛妖，很好。以后就做我的小队长。”豹二十平静的说道，很难让人想起上午他还带着一脸媚笑的向虎统领讨饶。

“是，统领。”雷豪看了看豹二十，低头回答道。心里想着：看来，这豹二十也是个有野心的妖怪啊，只是，你有你的野心我也有我的算盘。
content_en:
Early the next morning, Lei Hao heard bursts of noise while he was still sleeping. He muttered in a hazy state, "Fat man, it's so early to fuck your sister. Be quiet and let me sleep for a while." After saying that, he turned over, and the hard stone bed made him feel something was wrong. His bed couldn't be so hard. He woke up at this moment. He didn't dare to open his eyes. He touched it with his hand in the darkness, and then let go of his hand dejectedly.He slowly opened his eyes and saw the dark cave ceiling instead of the snow-white ceiling he was familiar with.

He climbed up from the hard, cold stone bed in despair.In other words, if his fragile body as a college student had slept like this all night, he would probably suffer from backache and leg cramps now.

Standing at the door of the stone room, Lei Hao watched the little demons outside busy coming and going. He was confused and didn't know what to do.

"Brother, come here quickly, the Commander-in-Chief is about to start practicing." Lei Hao was in a daze when Leopard Twenty looked at him from a distance and shouted.When Lei Hao saw Leopard Twenty calling him, he quickly walked over. This Leopard Demon was now his priority, and he might not offend Leopard Twenty. "No matter what, let's survive." Lei Hao said to himself secretly.

Leopard Twenty took Lei Hao, and a large group of little demons, calling for friends along the way, rushed towards the cave entrance.When Lei Hao and the others arrived at the Dongkou school grounds, a dark mass of monsters had already gathered there.Yes, it was completely dark. Lei Hao remembered that when watching Journey to the West, every time Sun Wukong knocked on the door, those demon kings would rush out with dozens of little demons. Now it seems really fucking nonsense. This requires at least two to three thousand little demons.

"Leopard Twenty, look at what time it is. New Demon doesn't know. Or do you, as a small commander, not know what time it is?" Lei Hao heard a loud shout from far away, especially the word "small" was bitten very clearly, and the sound was like a tiger's roar.After taking a closer look, he saw that it was a tiger demon, two feet tall, with arms thicker than the current Lei Hao's thighs.The fierce expression made Lei Hao's legs weaken.

Leopard Twenty looked up at the sky, then walked towards the tiger demon with a flattering smile and a hunched waist. It was really hard for him to have such a complicated expression on his wretched and ferocious face."Commander Tiger, it was the younger one who made the mistake. Just go around the younger one this time." Leopard Twenty said to the tiger demon in a flattering manner.

"Huh, spare me? I spared you too many times, and you were defeated by those weaklings in the Snake Demon Cave last time. Tiger Seven and Tiger Eight will give them a hundred whips to give them a long memory, so that they can remember the rules of our dirty water cave." The tiger demon shouted.

Leopard Twenty's expression changed, but he still lay down on the ground quickly. Leopard Twenty, who had lived in Shuizang Cave for more than a hundred years, knew very well that the Tiger Commander in front of him was very difficult to mess with. He was one of the only three Inner Alchemy realm demons in Shuizhang Cave, and even the Tiger Commander would share some of the treasures that the king got every time.

Lei Hao couldn't react when he saw Leopard 20 just lying on the ground, ready to be whipped. Didn't he just talk about training?Will you be whipped if you are late?Does it need to be so serious as to be whipped a hundred times?He obviously thought this was college.

Seeing Leopard Twenty lying on the ground, all the little demons under Leopard Twenty hurriedly fell to the ground, as if they were afraid of falling too late.Although Lei Hao is unwilling, there is no better way now. Resist?Nonsense, look at the Tiger Commander, he is a head taller than Lei Hao, not to mention the tiger teeth in his mouth, but look at the Tiger Commander's arms, they are thicker than his own thighs.Although it was painful to travel as a little demon, he hadn't thought about traveling again so soon. Who knows if he died this time and became an X-movie hero or if he traveled to other animals. This time, he had a human form. It would be great fun to transform into other animals.

Two tiger demons quickly came over with a group of little demons, and the execution began. A pig demon as fat as a hill whipped Lei Hao's body with a whip.

It hurts. The little demon with a low IQ doesn't understand what "letting go" means. Although we are all monsters, this pig demon seems to know that it must have been a monster for much longer than Lei Hao.The face is more ferocious and more powerful.Lei Hao originally thought it was nothing. Even Bao Erwen, the young commander, was whipped, so there was nothing uncomfortable about it.But he forgot that he was a human in his heart, and those were monsters.

The whip continued, one whip after another on Lei Hao's body, and also on Lei Hao's heart, shattering the hypocritical protective shell he had built up during his more than ten years of studying.

This mysterious and magnificent world of Journey to the West greeted the still somewhat ignorant Lei Hao with this whip.

Humiliation kept biting Lei Hao's heart. He was vulgar, he was ordinary, and he knew that he was nothing.But he was also passionate.He can't forget the scenes when he fought with others in middle school, the scenes where he and his brother were injured but laughed so wildly, the scenes where they were beaten in a crowd but tried to support each other and didn't want to fall. He couldn't forget all of this.It's just that reality forced him to be hypocritical, forced him to give up his fist and pick up a pen; forced him to retract all the outward edges towards himself, which stung him so many times that he cried alone at midnight.But in order to prevent his parents from going around apologizing to people because of him, in order that his parents would not be gossiped about by relatives and friends, and in order for his parents to stop bending over and giving away their hard-earned money to others.His blood has become cold, and he will let it go if he suffers a small loss, and tolerates a little anger. He feels that he can be shameless, and dignity does not matter anymore.

But now Lei Hao, who was whipped by a pig demon, realized that the indifference he had always felt was a lie. It turned out that his blood was still hot. He could not be whipped severely and could swallow his anger and pretend that nothing happened.He gritted his teeth and stared at the tiger monster, which didn't even look at Lei Hao. He didn't even know that his mouth was full of blood."They all have no strength, they all have no strength. I want to have strength, I want to have the strength of the Demon King. This tiger monster dares to whip me? I want to have the strength of Sun Wukong, and this tiger monster dares to whip me? I want to have the strength of Taishang Laojun, and this tiger monster dares to whip me? I want to have the strength of Hongjun, and this tiger monster dares to whip me?" Lei Hao howled crazily in his heart. He has never been as eager for strength as he is now, so eager to have the strength to protect his dignity.

Unlike the little demons around him who screamed one after another, Lei Hao remained silent from the beginning to the end. It wasn't that he was thick-skinned and didn't hurt, nor that his endurance was so good. It was just that he didn't want to shout out. Screaming out meant that he had given up. He just stared at the commander Hu with blood and received a full hundred whips.

The tiger demon who even forgot Lei Hao's name a few years later didn't know what kind of existence he had awakened with this whip. He didn't know until he died in Lei Hao's hands.

The 100 whips were finally finished, and those who were whipped were basically the little demons who had just been enlightened yesterday. They had low strength and low physical strength, and those who could be executed were the former demon soldiers. Although they were both little demons, their strength was at least twice as strong as them. After this whip, except for Leopard Twenty, who stood up and patted the dust on his body, the others were basically unable to get up.The flesh and blood were so blurred that you could vaguely see the white bones. How could you get up? The weaker ones were already taking in more air than outgoing, and were about to die.Not to mention that the Tiger Demon Commander didn't even see any change in Leopard Twenty's face. The Demon Clan respects the strong, and the losers without strength will die as well.

The tiger demon leader turned his head and looked at the group of chirping "wounded demons" on the ground, waved his hands impatiently and said: "You bunch of trash, go back. You won't be here for today's drill." His expression was like chasing away a group of disgusting flies.

Lei Hao, who had just breathed a sigh of relief after hearing the tiger demon leader's words and was about to go back to the cave to recuperate, was stabbed again by the tiger demon leader's expression.He took a deep breath, held on to the ground with both hands, and climbed up little by little. Although the pain caused the veins in his hands to rise and his face to turn blue and red, he remained silent.

"Commander Tiger, little Niu Shisan requested to join the drill." Lei Hao stood up and shouted loudly, as if the louder the voice would be, the less pain would be felt on his body. Although he was shouting "younger," his honest face was now full of determination, without any flattery.

The tiger demon turned his head and glanced again when he heard Lei Hao's voice. His eyes stayed on Lei Hao for a few seconds and then moved away. He didn't take Lei Hao seriously at all. He didn't even know how many of these little demons he had killed with his own hands.

"Get in." He shouted softly this time without even turning his head.

Lei Hao walked toward the demon group step by step. The blood flowing from his body reflected the dazzling light under the sunlight that had just risen. It was like a long neon light avenue, which made Leopard 20 behind Lei Hao silent. He just stared at Lei Hao's bloody back, not knowing what to think about.

=============================Divider================================

After the training, Lei Hao, whose face was so pale that there was no trace of blood left, returned to the stone room. It was almost noon, and the little demons were already busy cooking. Even though the smell of meat was filling the room, the body odor of various little demons in the dirty water cave was so clear.But Lei Hao had no appetite at all. He had been practicing with injuries all morning, and he broke out in cold sweats. Now he felt like he was seriously ill.But he didn't regret not going back to the cave to recuperate. It was just to tell himself that he, Lei Hao, could still fight and had not been destroyed by the hypocritical world.Although the whole morning's training was of little use to his physical body, it was the first step towards overcoming his laziness.

He wants to become a strong person, and a strong person will become a strong person by being strong.

Lei Hao lay on the cold stone bed, frowning and sucking in the air. When he was in a state of confusion and about to fall into coma, a sound of footsteps quickly stopped in front of his stone bed from far to near."Brother Niu, brother Niu, wake up." Lei Hao opened his eyes with great effort, and saw that it was Leopard Twenty, holding a large basin of meat in his hand.

"Commander Leopard, why are you here?" Lei Hao struggled to get up, "Brother, brother, don't move. Come, I brought you some blood food. You were injured today. Eat more and you will heal quickly." Leopard Twenty stopped Lei Hao and put the basin in front of Lei Hao.Only then did Lei Hao see clearly what was in the basin. It was meat, but it was all raw meat, bloody and steaming raw meat.

Lei Hao felt his stomach churn. Leopard 20 looked at Lei Hao and said calmly: "We demon clan can only be strong by eating blood food. It's just that those losers started eating cooked food just to satisfy their cravings. After swallowing these blood food and replenishing some blood, your injury will be healed tomorrow. I have survived many serious injuries this way."
